title: Subjective and objective measurement methods for determining the coupling quality of the Vibrant Soundbridge to middle ear structures
summary: The aim is to verify how well the middle ear implant has been implanted in the existing middle ear structures.

interventions.name: All patients who are treated with a VSB in the period: 01.04.2025-28.02.2030.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Persons who are supplied with a VSB from MED-EL
Exclusion criteria:
People with neurological limitations or pre-existing conditions
